title: Keep the app

blocks.md:
## Yours to keep

A continuing app is a folder you can take with you, not a throwaway drill. Passing **Filter the list** saved that creation under this learner. **Export creation** writes the folder or zip off this machine. The point of a keep step is that the list can now do something it could not at the start: hide items that do not match the query.

This bites when you treat the previous lesson as finished-and-gone. If you never export, the work lives only in this app's user data. A reinstall of the lesson pack does not replace your creation, but a new machine will not have it unless you take the files with you.

```javascript
filterList(["lamp", "fuse", "loop"], "l");
// -> "lamp,loop"  — the list now hides what does not match
```

A common mistake is thinking export is a pack zip or a settings backup. Those are different objects. The prompt asks you to say, in your own words, what new thing the list can do after the filter lesson.

blocks.promptMd: What new thing can the list do after the filter lesson?

description: Keep the list you built and take it with you.
